summary: This is an operating policy rather than one product feature. Current tools provide the layer controls and evidence needed to move deliberately between planning, implementation and aggregate supervision.

items.text: Claude Code permission modes: plan, edit and autonomous modes make shifts between analysis and execution explicit and reversible.
Aider chat modes: ask, architect and code modes separate design discussion from direct editing within one session.
LangSmith evaluations and traces: aggregate experiment results can support a move upward while individual traces preserve drill-down when signals degrade.
